title: Response Cache Plugin
description: Configures the exact-match LLM response cache and the opt-in tool-result cache.

namespace.description: Required trust-domain name folded into every key. Do not share one namespace across mutually untrusted tenants or upstreams.

ttl_seconds.description: How long a stored answer stays reusable, in seconds. Must be greater than zero.

priority.description: LLM execution intercept priority. Lower values run first; give guardrails a lower priority so they run on cache hits.

bypass_rate.description: Probability from 0.0 to 1.0 of skipping the cache and running live to refresh the stored answer.

cache_nondeterministic.description: Also cache requests that are not pinned to temperature 0.

key_strategy.description: How LLM cache keys are derived. `logical` ignores tool-description wording while preserving tool interfaces.

header_allowlist.description: Request headers, matched case-insensitively, folded into the key. Authentication headers are rejected.

backend.description: Storage backend shared by the LLM and tool caches.

max_bytes.description: In-memory byte budget before oldest-first eviction.

tools.description: Opt-in tool-result cache. Cache only tools that are read-only and stable for their TTL.

cache_errors.description: Allow conventional in-band tool error results to be stored.

overrides.description: Per-tool refinements keyed by exact name, `prefix*`, `*suffix`, or `*contains*`.

executor.description: SDK Tokio executor settings. The cache needs Tokio for its stores and streaming copy.

tool_class.description: Caching policy shared by a class of tools.

cacheable.description: Whether members may be served from cache.

ttl_seconds.description: TTL in seconds; inherits the cache TTL when unset.

bypass_rate.description: Live-rerun probability; inherits the cache rate when unset.

tool_version.description: Version string folded into member keys.

arg_skip.description: Top-level argument keys dropped before keying.

tool_override.description: Per-tool refinement applied after class resolution.

tool_version.description: Version string folded into the key.

arg_skip.description: Replaces the class argument skip list.
